ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 15:85 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density white mottling concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered white focal points across the central black field; linear high-intensity banding along the visible portion of the left leading edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate 75-degree interior angle; clearly defined apex dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; distinct peaks and valleys ranging from 5-15 pixels in amplitude relative to the primary contour line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge from the notch to the distal tips, terminating in an upward-tapering sweep at the outer points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular clusters at the distal tip of the left lobe; dense white speckling at the distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-left quadrant of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and mottling at the distal tips of both lobes; multiple small, discrete circular depigmentation marks on the lower half of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of the fluke base and peduncle region due to high-contrast water spray and splashing.
